notes: Round 58. GEO refused: the only source is a Wikipedia infobox naming one firm while the same article says three firms collaborated on that series without saying which printed it.

records.detail: Industry body (International Association of Currency Affairs) profile of the Banque Centrale de Mauritanie 20-ouguiya polymer note launched 28 November 2021; a third-party announcement, not confirmed on the bank's own site.
records.source_title: Product Owner: Banque Centrale de Mauritanie - 20 Ouguiya
records.quote: The new note is printed by Canadian Banknote Company whilst supported by CCL Secure for the Guardian polymer substrate.

records.detail: Bank of Uganda's director of currency Dr Bazizi told a parliamentary committee that the bank's banknote printing contract is with Oberthur Fiduciaire, signed 26 July 2018; reported by The Independent (Uganda).
records.source_title: BoU complained to money printer for breach of contract - The Independent Uganda
records.quote: the contract between BOU and M/s Oberthur Fiduciare was entered into in July 26, 2018

records.name_as_stated: Imprimerie Oberthur / the French company Oberthur
records.detail: Wikipedia's article on the convertible mark states all denominations except the KM 200 are printed by Oberthur; not confirmed on the Central Bank of Bosnia and Herzegovina's own site.
records.source_title: Bosnia and Herzegovina convertible mark - Wikipedia
records.quote: Banknotes, with the exception of the KM 200 note, are printed by the French company Oberthur.

records.detail: Wikipedia states OeBS was selected after an international tender to print the KM 200 note; not confirmed on the Central Bank of Bosnia and Herzegovina's own site.
records.source_title: Bosnia and Herzegovina convertible mark - Wikipedia
records.quote: After an international tender, the Austrian company Oesterreichische Banknoten und Sicherheitsdruck GmbH (OeBS) was selected to print the KM 200 note.

records.detail: Wikipedia's article on the Iraqi dinar says the 2003 series, still the basis of circulating notes, was printed by De La Rue; not confirmed on the Central Bank of Iraq's own site.
records.quote: with the notes printed by De La Rue again

records.detail: Wikipedia's article on the Israeli new shekel names Orell Füssli Security Printing of Switzerland as the printer of the banknotes, including the polymer note; the Bank of Israel's own currency pages name no printer.
records.quote: The banknotes are printed by Orell Füssli Security Printing of Switzerland.
